title: 拿破仑的数学水平
excerpt: 按照综合理工高材生尚布雷的说法，在日后的炮兵军官生涯里中，学校里的那些高深数学知识几乎没有派上过用场，最后忘了个精光
excerpt_en: According to the École Polytechnique alumnus Chambray, in his later career as an artillery officer the advanced mathematics taught at school was almost never of any use and was eventually forgotten completely
